title: Collaborative: Everyone is unhappy
description: Congratulations! You’re building a collaborative! Your mission is simple: work with a group of passionate, thoughtful people to solve a problem no single organisation can solve alone. Difficulty level: Impossible Estimated completion time: Unknown Power: Collective Optimism  Level 1: Synchronise calendars Your first quest seems straightforward: Find one hour when everyone is free. Bonus Challenge: Manage global participants. “Did you mean EST or IST?”, “Your morning or mine?” After 9.5 atte
